about: The one mail program hub-mail uses for Gmail: Himalaya, pinned to one release and one archive per kind of computer. hub-mail-imap.js downloads the archive for this computer, refuses it unless its SHA-256 matches the line below, and keeps it in ~/.hub/mail/imap/bin. It never upgrades it by itself and never touches a Himalaya the person installed. A kind of computer is offered only when `tested` names a real run on it; the others get the paste-and-draft fallback.
